text: Define a random experiment.

points.text: An experiment whose outcome can’t be known in advance, though all its outcomes are known.

subject: mathematics
text: Define an outcome.

points.text: One possible result of a random experiment.

subject: mathematics
text: Define an event.

points.text: A subset of the sample space.

subject: mathematics
text: Define an impossible event.

points.text: The empty subset of the sample space, which can never happen.

subject: mathematics
text: Define a sure event.

points.text: The whole sample space, which always happens.

subject: mathematics
text: Define a simple event.

points.text: An event with one sample point.

subject: mathematics
text: Define a compound event.

points.text: An event with more than one sample point.

subject: mathematics
text: Define complementary events.

points.text: An event and “not” that event, one of which must happen but not both.

subject: mathematics
text: Define the axiomatic approach to probability.

points.text: A way of defining probability by rules: each event has a value from 0 to 1, a sure event has 1, and exclusive events add.
